quality.external_dependencies_review: Java InputStream, org.w3c.dom.Document, javax.xml.parsers and org.xml.sax APIs are available. Implement the method in its existing class; no application-specific helpers are needed.

original_metadata.cve_description: Logisim Evolution version 2.14.3 and earlier contains an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in Circuit file loading functionality (loadXmlFrom in src/com/cburch/logisim/file/XmlReader.java) that can result in information leak, possible RCE depending on system configuration. This attack appears to be exploitable via the victim opening a specially crafted circuit file. This vulnerability appears to have been fixed in 2.14.4.
